contract.purpose: Map user image attachments into provider-compatible multimodal chat payload parts while keeping file attachments text-backed.
contract.scope: Client payload assembly for image `dataUrl` attachments, mixed text-plus-image user turns, and attachment replay expectations.

invariants.invariant-1: File attachments contribute bounded text context via excerpts; image attachments become `image_url` content parts only when `dataUrl` exists.
invariants.invariant-2: Provider payload receives multimodal `content` parts but never raw local `attachments` metadata.
invariants.invariant-3: Image-send path is gated conservatively by endpoint/model heuristics; unsupported routes degrade to text-only turns instead of sending risky multimodal payloads.
invariants.invariant-4: Explicit model capability metadata from `/models` overrides heuristics when available.
